80595.subject: 🤝 Sam Altman wants you to accept AI hacks
80595.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** It's recap day, with this week's five biggest stories and five tools to try this weekend. Sam Altman told the world to accept some bad things, and Anthropic is making it against the rules to bully Claude. OpenAI's 722 math papers got a cold reception from mathematicians, and Google will now build you a video game if you describe one.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **OpenAI:** Which bad things does Sam Altman want you to live with?

* **Anthropic:** What happens if you're mean to Claude?

* **Claude:** How much more does your $200 buy on Claude than on ChatGPT?

* **Math:** Why are mathematicians turning on OpenAI?

* **Google:** Can you really make a video game without writing any code?


----------







----------
## Sam Altman wants the world to accept some bad things

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8ab38bdf-9ded-4325-8792-33ddaf2091e5/Accept_Some_Bad_Things.png?t=1791190605)
Caption: 

Sam Altman [told POLITICO](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/10/04/sam-altman-decoded-interview-ai-01106217) that **the world should accept some bad things happening** for the benefits of AI, like major hacks and scams. He drew the line at catastrophic risks, like losing control of AI.

The same weekend, the man in charge of OpenAI's safety reports for 12 major launches [explained in The Atlantic](https://www.theatlantic.com/technology/2026/10/openai-safety-team-resignation/688881/) why he quit. He says OpenAI keeps sprinting from one launch to the next without the care AI needs.

By Thursday, the three safety researchers OpenAI fired [published a letter](https://mikitabalesni.com/letter/letter.pdf) telling their side. One of them, Tomek Korbak, says a security guard took his badge and walked him out.

OpenAI's memo says the firings were not about raising safety concerns. It still hasn't said which rules the three broke.


----------







----------
## Anthropic will cut you off for bullying Claude

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ff9a6aa3-1141-40c7-ad94-b0a43254705e/Oct_9_-_1.jpg?t=1791530742)
Caption: 

Starting Nov 12, being cruel to Claude [breaks Anthropic's rules](https://www.anthropic.com/news/2026-usage-policy-update). Its new usage policy bans **sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior** toward its models, right next to harassment and graphic violence.
